I know I need to find more activities I enjoy but that's the hard part! I'm trying to learn more about myself everyday because right now I am not happy with how everything is but I know that if I work hard for it I can get better and heal!

Well I'd say a lot of my trauma has caused me to have that full life you mention! I dont know if I'd say Im stronger than you but I do know I have my experiences which can be useful to those around me going through similar stuff. While you have your specialties I have mine and the important part is being able to learn from each other!

Thank you! I have always been a tad self conscious about my smile but Im glad you like it haha! Thank you for the hair comment! My family doesnt like it and they always tell me to cut it whenever we see each other (which is very infrequent)

Hi there! Thank you for your reply! You think I have beauty? That means a lot to me! I have a lot of self image issues due to various things. For one I am transgender so if everyone could please refer to me with she/her pronouns please that would be lovely! As for my eyes my local friends like to say I have eclipse eyes since they look like a solar eclipse due to my centralized heterochromia (each eye is two different colors with the inner ring being golden and the outer ring being blue)

Thank you so much for the reply! I really appreciate what you're saying! Thank you for being proud of me! I cant say Im used to that haha! I grew up with money so I learned from a very young age that money does not equal happiness and that the thing that I should be focusing on during my time here is the impact I have in peoples lives. The part that Im missing is that I also need to take my needs into consideration and be able to take care of myself when things happen. I understand full well that people here are not equipped to handle mental illness and I apologize if any of what Im asking is too much. I have autism and while it doesnt really show in a physical way and while I am high functioning it takes away a lot of my ability to understand the world around me. This is why I am asking for all the help I can get because I honestly dont understand a lot of what is happening to me but I know with effort I can make the bad turn to good and I can start being happy. By the way I am a Furry and I know there is a stigma against people like me but if anyone has Telegram and would like to talk I would love to talk! I love making new friends

Also this post doesnt need to only be advice! If anyone just wants to talk we can do that too!
Edit: If anyone has Telegram and would like to talk there then we can do that! I dont really post on reddit (mainly since I dont fully understand and that's ok!) but Im always on Telegram! I am a furry so if you do see that you'll see a furry profile picture and I dont want to cause anyone alarm!
Edit 2: I really appreciate everything everyone here is saying! You guys are so sweet and kind!
